errors.unexpected: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.

students.title: Students
students.intro: Students of the school. The academic year is the one selected in the selector in the top bar.
students.caption: List of students

empty.title: There are no students to show
empty.text: Create the first student of the school.

confirmRestore.title: Restore {name}
confirmRestore.description: The student will appear again in the list of students. If their person record no longer exists or they already have another student record, the system will prevent it.

detail.saved: The student's data have been saved.
detail.readOnlyYear: The selected academic year is read-only: no changes can be made.

confirmDelete.title: Withdraw {name}
confirmDelete.description: Withdrawal is logical: it does not delete the person or their membership of the family unit, and it can be restored. It is not allowed while there is an active enrollment.

form.createDescription: Personal data of the student. The family unit is optional.
form.editDescription: Only the data you change is sent. Membership of the family unit is managed in Families.
form.documentKeep: Current document: {masked}. Leave it blank to keep it; if you enter a new one, also indicate the type.

familyPicker.hint: The student is added to the chosen family unit. Requires permission to modify families.
familyPicker.empty: There are no family units with that code.
familyPicker.loadError: The family units could not be loaded.

photo.title: Photo
photo.expired: The photo link has expired. Show it again.
photo.hint: JPEG o PNG, hasta 5 MB. El servidor reprocesa la imagen y descarta sus metadatos.
photo.tooLarge: The file exceeds the 5 MB limit.
photo.wrongType: The file must be a JPEG or PNG image.

confirmRemove.title: Remove the photo of {name}
confirmRemove.description: The photo will no longer be available. You can upload another one afterwards.

guardians.title: Guardians and emergency contact
guardians.hint: Vínculos del alumno con sus tutores. Consultarlos queda registrado en la auditoría, por eso solo se piden al pulsar el botón.
guardians.empty: The student has no guardian links.
guardians.caption: Guardian links of the student

consents.title: Consentimiento de imagen
consents.empty: No hay consentimientos de imagen registrados.
consents.caption: Consentimiento de imagen del alumno

enrollments.title: Enrolments
enrollments.caption: Enrolments of the student
enrollments.createDescription: Enrolment in the selected academic year. The group is optional and can be assigned later.
enrollments.withdrawDescription: The enrolment in {course} becomes withdrawn and is kept in full. This cannot be undone.
enrollments.optionsLoadError: The courses and groups could not be loaded.
enrollments.groupsLoadError: The groups could not be loaded.

confirmCancel.title: Cancel the enrolment in {course}
confirmCancel.description: Cancelling deletes the enrolment as if it had never existed (for example, if it was created by mistake). For a transfer or a withdrawal, use “Withdraw enrolment”.

groupChange.title: Request group change
groupChange.description: Request to move {student} from group {group} to another group in the same course. Another person with the required permission must approve it.
groupChange.toGroupHint: Only groups in the same course are offered.
groupChange.noGroups: There are no other groups in this course.
groupChange.requested: The group change request has been sent.

classList.title: Class lists
classList.intro: Enrolments in the selected academic year. Filter by course, group and status; the course and the group are optional.
classList.caption: Class list
classList.readOnlyYear: The selected academic year is read-only: the list can be exported, but group change requests cannot be made.

empty.title: There are no enrolments to show
empty.text: Try other filters or another academic year.

groupChanges.title: Group change requests
groupChanges.intro: Requests for the selected academic year. The school office submits them from the student record or the class list; here they are approved, rejected or cancelled.
groupChanges.caption: Group change requests
groupChanges.readOnlyYear: The selected academic year is read-only: no requests can be approved, rejected or cancelled.
groupChanges.noYear: There is no active or selected academic year: choose one to see its requests.

empty.title: There are no requests to show
empty.text: Try other filters or another academic year.

approve.title: Approve the request
approve.description: The group change of {student} (from group {from} to group {to}) will be made. The person who made the request cannot approve it.

reject.title: Reject the request
reject.description: The group change of {student} (from group {from} to group {to}) will be rejected. Please state the reason for the rejection.

cancel.title: Cancel the request
cancel.description: The group change of {student} (from group {from} to group {to}) will be cancelled.
